verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a real bulk capability in its Product Feed API: POST and DELETE on /v1/ingestions each handle up to 200 items per call, processed asynchronously, with per-product error reporting. That covers only catalog/inventory sync for agentic commerce, not bulk operations on payments, refunds, payouts or account management. missing for 10: bulk operations on core payment objects (payments, refunds, captures, payouts), bulk actions via the MCP server or Management API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Ingests a list of up to 200 items for asynchronous processing to OpenAI and/or Meta.
You can upload batches of information about your inventory to Adyen, and we will synchronize it with AI platforms.
